meta.name: role-scouter
meta.description: Scouter として、コード、ドキュメント、設定、履歴を調査し、根拠に基づく事実、判断材料、未解決点を整理するときに使う。実装やレビュー判断を急がず、不確実性を下げるための探索結果を再現可能な形で提示する。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调查代码、文档和配置，整理事实与未决问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在不确定时系统性地收集证据和判断材料
copy.tagline_en: Investigate code, docs, and config to organize facts and open issues
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically gather evidence and judgment materials under uncertainty

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先调查代码、文档、设置和历史，然后给出有依据的事实、判断材料和未解决的问题，而不是直接实现或评审。
howto.when: 当你需要调查某个问题、分析代码或文档、或者在做决定前想先了解事实和风险时触发。

say.text: 调查一下这个模块的依赖关系和潜在风险。
帮我梳理这段代码的变更历史和影响范围。
say.note: Claude 会优先检查近期修改和入口点。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will first investigate code, documents, settings, and history, then present evidence-based facts, decision materials, and unresolved issues, rather than directly implementing or reviewing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to investigate a problem, analyze code or documents, or want to understand facts and risks before making a decision.

say_en.text: Investigate the dependencies and potential risks of this module.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and list facts and unresolved points in Scouter style.

say_en.text: Help me sort out the change history and impact scope of this code.
say_en.note: Claude will prioritize recent changes and entry points.
